hero.texto: The Theological Education Center of the Assemblies of God Piracicaba is the theological education institution dedicated to training members, workers, and evangelical leaders, both in person and at a distance.

missao.texto: Equip members, workers, and leaders of the Assemblies of God in Piracicaba with solid theological training, both in person and at a distance.

ensino.texto: Official courses, periodic refresher courses, and theology at progressive levels — from beginner to advanced.

alcance.texto: A single portal serving multiple fields and ministries, so that distance is never an obstacle to training.

diretoria.subtitulo: Leadership responsible for the institutional, academic, and administrative direction of the educational center.

cta.texto: Submit your application and our office will reach out with next steps.
